$comment: Encodes the Autonomy section of CLAUDE.md as actual permissions. CLAUDE.md prose only governs whether Claude asks a question in chat; this file governs the tool-permission gate. Keep rules generic - a rule with literal file paths in it can never match twice. Do not re-add rules for ls/cat/echo/head/tail/grep/find/wc/which/diff/stat/du/cd or read-only git: those are a built-in read-only set that never prompts in any mode, so such rules are no-ops. sed is NOT in that set (it has write-capable flags), hence the sed rules below.
